instruction: Create a zip archive named 'mountains.zip' in the Pictures directory containing all three mountain pictures.

result.command: python3 -c "import os; import zipfile; import json; zip_path = '/home/user/Pictures/mountains.zip'; result = {'zip_exists': os.path.exists(zip_path)}; if result['zip_exists']: zf = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r'); result['files_in_zip'] = sorted(zf.namelist()); zf.close(); print(json.dumps(result))"
